EXOParameter.description:
A measured value, its asymmetric uncertainties, and its own provenance.
An absent table means no parameter was supplied. NaN means a missing numeric
cell, including when the archive supplies a reference or limit but no value.

ERR1.description: Archive ERR1 (positive) and ERR2 (negative), retained without symmetrizing.

LIMIT.description:
Archive limit flag: 0 measurement, +1 upper limit, -1 lower limit.
-128 means the source did not supply a flag; it is not a measurement.

DISPLAY.description: Archive display string, if supplied, preserved without parsing/rounding.

UNIT.description:
Unit of VALUE/ERR1/ERR2, using IVOA VOUnits (d, deg, AU, K, or 1).
Earth radius/mass are archive units R_earth and M_earth, not SI estimates.

REFERENCE_BIBCODE.description:
ADS bibcode when provided or unambiguously present in the source link.
Absent means unknown; archive references are not always ADS publications.

REFERENCE_TEXT.description: The complete source reference cell, including archive reflink markup.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC retrieval time of this parameter's source.

GAIA_DR3_ID.description: Archive identifier string, e.g. Gaia DR3 <source_id>. Never a JS number.

PL_ORBPER.description: Period in days; semimajor axis in AU; eccentricity dimensionless.

PL_ORBLPER.description:
Argument of periastron and orbital inclination in degrees. The archive
preserves each publication's convention (planet/star omega may differ).

PL_TRANMID.description: Transit midpoint T0 and periastron epoch Tp, JD in their named systems.

LONG_ASC_NODE.description:
Longitude of ascending node Omega, degrees in the stated reference frame.
Not a PSCompPars column; absence must never become an assumed zero.

PL_PROJOBLIQ.description: Sky-projected spin-orbit obliquity lambda, degrees (not true 3D obliquity).

PL_RADE.description: Planet radius in Earth radii; best mass in Earth masses with its basis.

PL_BMASSPROV.description:
Archive provenance token, e.g. Mass, Msini, M-R relationship. A measured
m*sin(i) is not silently promoted to mass; an estimate remains labeled.

PL_EQT.description: Equilibrium temperature in kelvin, with the source's model assumptions.

GEOMETRIC_ALBEDO.description:
Dimensionless geometric albedo, distinct from Bond albedo. Not currently
in PSCompPars; source/band are explicit when a publisher supplies it.

DISCOVERYMETHOD.description: Archive discovery-method token, preserved verbatim for new techniques.

PL_CONTROV_FLAG.description: Original archive flag: 0 not controversial, 1 controversial, -1 absent.

STATUS_REFERENCE.description: Reference explaining status, especially disputes or retractions.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC retrieval time, and replayable source table/query URL.
